From: Connor Obrien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Discovery recap + ask on approval runway and blockers

Hi Ben / Alicia —

Thanks again for taking the time yesterday. Quick recap from my side and a few asks so we can map next steps on our end: 

What we covered
- Use case: FinLytics wants to embed low-latency summarization and private embeddings for customer transaction data.
- Key constraints: PII controls, on-prem/private deployment option for audit logs, 99th %ile latency target <120ms for small responses.
- Initial target: 3-model pilot (2 embeddings models + 1 summarization) for 3 internal teams.

Open items / asks
1) Priority: Is this still a Q4 priority for FinLytics or should we plan for a Q1 rollout?
2) Approval gate: Who is the final approver for procurement (Finance or Product ops)? Any additional stakeholders we should loop in?
3) Timeline: Do you have a target date to have legal/Procurement sign-off?
4) Security evidence: I attached our SOC 2 summary and a short pricing worksheet — would that cover initial legal questions? If not, which artifacts should I gather?

Attachments: finlytics-multipage-sow-v1.pdf (SOW stub), redwood-pricing-summary.xlsx (pricing matrix)

Next steps I propose
- If Q4: a short 30-min approval sync with your approver + our Solutions Engineer next Monday (Nov 23) to walk the SOW and on-prem options.
- If timing slips: agree a small-footprint pilot to start earlier with a simple PO and delayed full deployment.

Would you confirm priority (Q4 vs Q1) and who the approver will be? I can get calendars open after hearing from you.

Thanks — appreciate the quick signal.

Best,
Connor Obrien
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

--
